name: Love Love ♥ Princess ~Ohime-sama ga Ippai! Motto Ecchi na Harem Seikatsu!!~
original_name: らぶらぶ♥プリンセス ～お姫さまがいっぱい！もっとエッチなハーレム生活!!～
source:
This harem comedy title follows their previous work Love Love Life, in collaboration with SkyFish. Born into a family of martial artists, Souji is a bit stronger than most people. One day, he was visited by the king and princesses from the Kingdom of Ellant, a nation of knights where power means everything. It seemed that the king had once been saved by Souji’s mother, and he wished to adopt him into the nation which is now only full of princesses.

Moreover, he was asked to choose one of the princesses as his bride, or more if he wished. They soon began fighting over who would be first and Souji, a true pervert at heart, suggested that he’ll marry them all and the first to get pregnant will become his first wife. It was a totally wild idea, but the king readily accepted it?!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这部后宫喜剧是继他们之前与SkyFish合作的作品《爱爱生活》之后推出的。总司出生于武术世家，比大多数人都要坚强一些。有一天，埃兰特王国的国王和公主拜访了他，埃兰特王国是一个以权力为一切的骑士国度。看来国王曾经被总司的母亲救过，他希望将他收养到现在只有公主的国家。

此外，他还被要求选择一位公主作为他的新娘，如果他愿意的话，也可以选择更多公主。他们很快就开始争论谁会是第一个，而宗次这个内心真正的变态者建议他嫁给他们所有人，而第一个怀孕的人将成为他的第一任妻子。这真是一个天马行空的想法，国王却欣然接受了？！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/07/12/july-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
